title: Ho Kaha bhayya mere aye Ali Akbar
body:
HO KAHA BHAYYA MERE AYE ALI AKBER
KHETI THI SUGHRA YAHI HAR GHADI ROKAR
Kaisi Aafat Aayi Hai Baap Hai Na Bhai Hai
Mai Watan Me Hu Magar Aalam-e-Tanhayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bin Tumhare Hogaya Suna Suna Ghar
Zindagi Mujhko Hai Bar Dil Hai Mera Be-Qarar
Ek Qayamat Ban Gaya Ab Ye Tera Intezar
Chalta Hai Qanjar Mere Dil Pe Reh-RehKar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tune Wada Tha Kiya Tujhko Lene Aaunga
Raat Din Ankhon Me Bas Rheta Hai Chera Tera
Kab Tu Aqir Aayega Shabi-e-Payghambar
Kab Se Mai Bimar Hu Jeene Se Bezarn Hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Kab Se Mai Bhayya Teri Talab-e-Deedar Hu
Hai Tamanna Dekhlu Tujhko Jeebhar Kar
Jhule Wala Na-Tawan Mera Bhai Be-Qarar
Dil Tadapta Hai Mera Usko Dhundhu Mai Kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad Aata Hai Bahut Wo Mera Asghar
Tha Yahi Sughra Ka Kaam Leke Bas Akber Ka Naam
Kheti Thi Ahsan Yahi Dekhti Hu Subh-o-Shaam
Tere Qadmoun Ke Nashan Hai Jo Mithi Par
